routingContract: The canonical key is agent_route/v1|<task-family>|<role>|<risk>. An exact task-family route wins; an unlisted task cell falls back to agent_route/v1|unknown|<role>|<risk>, then to the policy default.
taskAwareRouting: Task-specific cells and their unknown-family baselines share one v1 namespace. Task-specific cells are compiler-owned experiments until settled evaluation evidence promotes them.
taskEvidenceBoundary: Only the current causal instruction epoch creates a task family. Shell, file, and tool dispatch remain bounded action/role evidence, with shell actions classified by command head; dispatch does not select a task-specific route.
toolPolicy: All three tiers are tool-safe; supplied tools do not clamp the selected predictive route.
strongMutationObservation: A strong-model mutation that differs from the predicted action is recorded as a descriptive mismatch, never as an automatic quality verdict.
